control_profile: Exact target-sign inversion of the baseline with the same volatility target, drawdown brakes, position stop, and turnover cap.
falsifier: If the exact inversion materially outperforms the baseline, the declared trend direction is wrong; symmetric weakness instead supports the sign while exposing non-directional defects.
hypothesis: Negating every scheduled baseline target provides a clean direction diagnostic without changing selection, scale, schedule, or controls.
rebalance_horizon: weekly at the first UTC decision boundary
